en: A black-and-white image showing an industrial complex with several tall smokestacks, surrounded by fields and some trees. In the background, there are rolling hills, a small settlement of houses, and a prominent hilltop or monument visible on the right hill. The buildings appear to be early 20th-century European industrial architecture, with half-timbered details and pitched roofs.
